property_summary: For any admissible deposit amounts, after an account withdraws once the contract's balance must still hold every OTHER account's deposits (the reentrancy lock confines each withdrawal to the caller's own balance); deleting the lock lets a re-entrant withdrawer drain a second depositor's funds, leaving address(c).balance == 0 instead of the victim's deposit.
change_summary: Delete the statement '__lock_modifier0_lock = true;' from the modifier, removing the reentrancy guard so a reentrant call during the external call can double-withdraw and change balances at the attacker's key.
